driver_findings: No white-to-linear-density FFT normalization mismatch was detected against installed PMWD.

Windowing alone is insufficient: coverage remains 86-87 percent for nominal 68 percent and posterior mean correlation does not materially improve.
Residual SD near one with excessive central coverage suggests distribution-shape/tail mismatch; it is not a calibration pass.
About 15.5 percent of raw linear draw cells have delta<-1. This is admissible for a linear latent variable, but 1+delta cannot be promoted as a nonnegative physical matter density.

Truth uses nonlinear deposited mass and mass-weighted velocity; inference exports linear density/potential velocity and uses an exponential tracer link. These model definitions must be reconciled before a physical z=0 posterior claim.
